meta.title: Machine translation of execution narration
meta.description: Translates the agent's English progress narration into Simplified Chinese in place, leaving the final answer untouched. Coexists with the official reasoning-translation plugin.

notice.privacy: Privacy: text to translate is sent to a third-party translation service (Microsoft Bing free anonymous endpoint by default) and may contain project code, file contents, or other private information.
notice.scope: Scope: only the agent's English progress narration is translated. The final answer, reasoning (handled by the official plugin), tool records, user messages, code blocks, paths and already-Chinese text are left as-is.
